THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES11 / 20
ACCESS BELONGS IN THE SYSTEM

Clear by design.
Welcoming by default.

The supplied guide proposes WCAG 2.2 AA as a target. Use these checks during design and development, followed by testing with real content and assistive technology.

THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
PairContrastUse
White on brand green6.34:1Suitable for normal-size text.
Deep green on gold6.33:1Suitable for normal-size text.
Gold on brand green4.04:1Use for qualifying large text; avoid small functional copy.
White on gold1.57:1Avoid for functional text.
01

Perception

Provide meaningful alt text, readable contrast, text scaling and responsive reflow.

02

Keyboard

Support logical Tab order, a visible focus indicator and usable controls without a pointer.

03

Understanding

Use explicit labels, specific errors and clear status messages. Do not rely only on color.

04

Touch & regional text

Aim for 44 × 44 px mobile targets and test regional scripts on actual devices.

05

Verification

A checklist does not establish conformance. Test screen readers, zoom, keyboard access and reduced-motion behavior.
